facts.fact: The ICT minister Tatenda Mavetera announced that Zimbabwe's National Disability Policy and National ICT Policy would be reviewed to add accessibility guidelines, that every Community Information Centre must have a machine with braille software and assistive technology, and that the Universal Services Fund would subsidise assistive devices.
facts.system: National Disability Policy and National ICT Policy review

ZWE.note: The National ICT Policy review is announced only for accessibility guidelines; the document states no standing, text, period, plan or reporting for the policy.
